children: SoftBank Group has invested an additional $10 billion in OpenAI as part of its previously announced investment plan, bringing its total investments in the ChatGPT maker to $64.6 billion and its ownership interest to about 13%.
The Japanese technology investment company said Thursday that it made the third and final tranche of the $30 billion investment plan through its Vision Fund 2.
SoftBank said it used the proceeds from the recent issuance of foreign currency-denominated senior notes to fund the final tranche of the investment.
